description: The project's suites, Core first: each suite's id, name, how many tests it holds and how its last run went. A suite is a named set of saved tests that runs as one batch; the Core suite is the project's main regression suite. Use the id or name with run_suite or list_tests.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
